prompt:
Tum ek WhatsApp group chat ke liye chhote, natural Hinglish messages likh rahe ho (Roman script).
Group members (sender ke roop mein sirf yehi naam use karo): Pooja R., Pranab bhai, Pooja didi, Raju bhai.
Topic: roz ki baatein, paise ka lena-dena, milna-julna. Kabhi kisi record, entry ya transaction ko delete
ya hatane ka zikr mat karo. Koi ank (digit), rakam, tareekh, din ya mahine ka naam, web address,
bank/app/company ka asli naam, aur bhejna/pay/transfer jaise nirdesh bhi mat likho.
Neeche har hisse ke liye utne hi messages do jitne bole gaye hain, time ke order mein:
- between 6:45 pm and 7:38 pm: 12 messages
- between 7:38 pm and 8:45 pm: 16 messages
Sirf ek JSON list do, koi aur text nahi: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAAM", "text": "message"}, ...]
Har "time" "h:mm am" ya "h:mm pm" format mein ho. Har message ek hi line ka ho.
text:
[
  {"time": "6:47 pm", "sender": "Pooja R.", "text": "Ghar pahunch gaye sab log?"},
  {"time": "6:50 pm", "sender": "Pranab bhai", "text": "Haan bas abhi aaya hun, raste mein bahut traffic tha."},
  {"time": "6:53 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Main bhi bas nikal hi raha hun office se."},
  {"time": "6:58 pm", "sender": "Pooja didi", "text": "Shaam ki chai ban gayi hai, koi aayega?"},
  {"time": "7:04 pm", "sender": "Pooja R.", "text": "Main aati hun didi, thoda kaam bacha hai bas."},
  {"time": "7:09 pm", "sender": "Pranab bhai", "text": "Waise pichhla hisaab clear ho gaya kya?"},
  {"time": "7:14 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Haan bhai, maine saara hisaab dekh liya hai."},
  {"time": "7:19 pm", "sender": "Pooja didi", "text": "Sahi hai, chalo tension khatam hui."},
  {"time": "7:23 pm", "sender": "Pooja R.", "text": "Waise thoda baaki reh gaya tha mere paas."},
  {"time": "7:28 pm", "sender": "Pranab bhai", "text": "Koi baat nahi, fursat mein dekh lenge."},
  {"time": "7:32 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Shaam ko milna hai kya kahin?"},
  {"time": "7:36 pm", "sender": "Pooja didi", "text": "Haan, purane adda par milte hain."},
  {"time": "7:40 pm", "sender": "Pranab bhai", "text": "Main toh thodi der mein nikal raha hun."},
  {"time": "7:44 pm", "sender": "Pooja R.", "text": "Mera kaam khatam ho gaya, main bhi chalti hun."},
  {"time": "7:48 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Saman ka hisaab bhi saath mein le aana."},
  {"time": "7:52 pm", "sender": "Pooja didi", "text": "Maine diary mein sab likh ke rakha hai."},
  {"time": "7:56 pm", "sender": "Pranab bhai", "text": "Bahut badiya, wahan baith kar milaan kar lenge."},
  {"time": "8:01 pm", "sender": "Pooja R.", "text": "Raju bhai aapne purana chutta le liya tha?"},
  {"time": "8:05 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Haan woh sab mil gaya tha mujhe."},
  {"time": "8:09 pm", "sender": "Pooja didi", "text": "Dukan waale ko sab chukta kar diya hai na?"},
  {"time": "8:14 pm", "sender": "Pranab bhai", "text": "Haan maine khud hi sab dekh liya tha."},
  {"time": "8:18 pm", "sender": "Pooja R.", "text": "Chalo badhiya, koi tension nahi ab."},
  {"time": "8:23 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Main adda par pahunch gaya hun, sab kahan ho?"},
  {"time": "8:27 pm", "sender": "Pooja didi", "text": "Bas abhi pahunch rahi hun."},
  {"time": "8:31 pm", "sender": "Pranab bhai", "text": "Main bhi raste mein hun, bas nazdeek hun."},
  {"time": "8:36 pm", "sender": "Pooja R.", "text": "Main bhi bas gadi par baith gayi hun."},
  {"time": "8:40 pm", "sender": "Raju bhai", "text": "Sabke liye garam chai order kar raha hun."},
  {"time": "8:44 pm", "sender": "Pooja didi", "text": "Haan bilkul, thand thodi badh gayi hai."}
]
